name: agent-character-kit
description: Character-enforcement companion for ChatGPT and Codex. Thin client to the ACK daemon: habit skills plus fail-closed tool hooks. Deterrent, not a security boundary.

interface.shortDescription: Fail-closed character enforcement for agent tool calls
interface.longDescription: Packages ACK habits as skills and Codex lifecycle hooks. Policy stays in the ACK daemon. This plugin does not evaluate constitution or allow/deny lists locally. It is a deterrent and reminder, not a cage. No MCP server is bundled until the daemon exposes streamable HTTP.
